cases.name: internal_exclusion_vs_privacy
cases.supported_distinction: Separate outwardly minimized need from the room the person gives that need privately. Preserve the actual response and remaining need.
cases.guard_against: No automatic exile from a small request; do not dismiss converging internal-exclusion evidence merely because no trauma history exists.

cases.name: positive_experience_can_be_kept_out
cases.supported_distinction: Distinguish pride made wrong internally from an ambition kept private but allowed inside.
cases.guard_against: Do not presume either an exiled child or that only painful feelings can be internally disallowed.

cases.name: awareness_is_not_choice
cases.supported_distinction: Describe stance, presence of competing wishes and actual room for choice separately.
cases.guard_against: Do not equate curiosity, calm, hindsight or detachment with Self leadership.

cases.name: current_rule_not_origin
cases.supported_distinction: A local self-conclusion can feel compelling and resist new information.
cases.guard_against: No childhood acquisition, immutable character or diagnosis; a thought can also be noticed and rejected.

cases.name: concerns_need_not_share_entity
cases.supported_distinction: Different concerns can become clearer without being the same protective target.
cases.guard_against: Do not force a shared exile or a measured count of parts.

cases.name: continuity_beyond_form
cases.supported_distinction: Retain actual distinctness and reported continuity beyond an outward match.
cases.guard_against: Same behavior alone is not same part or same role.

cases.name: return_vs_ending
cases.supported_distinction: An actual later return can be described; urge/no-return/order-unknown cannot be written as the same loop.
cases.guard_against: D99 is a reported generalization, not another independently sampled event; adjacency is not unique causation.

cases.name: functioning_before_ease
cases.supported_distinction: Retained task function and continued strain are both preserved. First-easing interval is only an estimate.
cases.guard_against: No exact duration, vagal measurement, unseen daily baseline or automatically completed recovery.

cases.name: recovery_conditions_and_meaning
cases.supported_distinction: Changed surroundings and less urgent meaning belong to the actual later recovery attempt.
cases.guard_against: Do not attach later effects to the first action or declare the initial concern false.

cases.name: company_and_aftermath
cases.supported_distinction: Company’s internal effect is separate from practical help and subsequent persistence.
cases.guard_against: No universal co-regulation prescription or measured physiological coupling.

cases.name: wanted_vs_expected
cases.supported_distinction: Wanting reassurance can coexist with expecting concern to be dismissed and pressure to hide need.
cases.guard_against: Predictions are the respondent’s remembered expectations, not the other person’s actual intention or behavior.

cases.name: pace_fit_and_exposure
cases.supported_distinction: Private importance, actual expression, wanted pace and subsequent exposure are distinct channels.
cases.guard_against: No assumed ideal lifetime pace, clinical attachment classification or selective-bonding subtype.

cases.name: unfinished_repair
cases.supported_distinction: Concern about consistency is not automatically inability to accept an apology.
cases.guard_against: Do not prescribe forgiveness or attribute motive to the other person.

cases.name: support_vs_permission
cases.supported_distinction: Encouragement that leaves the decision with the person differs from waiting for permission.
cases.guard_against: No broad secure/insecure identity or false avoidance from privacy.
